core_principles.text: Peak recruitment of motor units can be accomplished at any workload greater than 60% 1 RM, provided momentary muscular fatigue is achieved.
Exercise intensity is best defined by the final repetition, as opposed to the initial repetition (i.e., percentage of 1RM).
Adhere to a controlled repetition duration, such as a 3-1-3-1 second tempo.

specific_findings.text: In a study of 12 resistance-trained subjects, percent MVC for the concentric portion of the final repetition of bicep curls was 62.5±27.8% at 40% 1RM, 71.7±24.0% at 60% 1RM, 72.8±18.4% at 80% 1RM, and 79.6±18.0% at 100% 1RM, with no significant difference among 60%, 80%, and 100% 1RM.
The recruitment of approximately 70% of MVC at momentary muscular fatigue may, in part, be attributed to the level of resistance training of the subjects and their ability to activate motor units.
